niche: the gap between an AI lab's controlled throughput benchmark and the language-model pretraining runs it plans, cause by cause, carried to each H1 2027 run's own conditions (data-parallel width and document mix, packing rule, hall power load, works calendar)
answer: Re-plan seven of the eleven H1 2027 runs: kide-120b-v1 (85.5 days against 75), kide-13b-code-lc32 (8.0 days against 7), kide-34b-16k (61.8 days against 54), kide-34b-lc64 (15.2 days against 13), kide-34b-sci (23.0 days against 20), kide-8b-lc64 (15.3 days against 13), kide-8b-v4 (79.5 days against 75) finish past their windows; kide-13b-lc32, kide-13b-v4, kide-34b-v3, kide-70b-v2 fit.
analyst_test: The careful but hurried pass reproduces each run's benchmark days, models the slowest data-parallel rank, best-fit padding, hall B's capped meter, interruptions and the works at the 2025-26 overrun record, and still files kide-34b-v3 late and kide-8b-v4 fitting: it holds the research pool at its 2026 mean share of the free nodes (its scheduler stops admitting jobs as the reservations near the contract, so with 800 nodes reserved in February to mid-March it is off and the hall nearly unthrottled) and carries every block at the benchmark's step (a job with nodes in both of hall B's pods runs about a fifth slower, and kide-8b-v4's block lies across them).
domain_test: The field's own statistics decide: an expected maximum over data-parallel ranks of a per-rank load quadratic in document length, the expected fill of a best-fit packing process under a heavy-tailed length mix, a throttle response measured on the intervals a hall crossed its cap, the step's penalty for a job laid across two pods and a research pool's share of the free nodes as a function of the load the reservations put on the hall; with warehouse or hospital nouns there is no rank to wait for, no packed sequence to pad, no spine between pods and no throughput benchmark to bridge.

world.org_type: AI research lab training its own language models on two leased GPU halls at a colocation campus

driver: Each future unit's rate sits at operating conditions no past unit reached and is rebuilt cause by cause from partial records at finer grains: the slowest of many parallel workers on a convex per-worker load, the expected fill of a packing process under a heavy-tailed size mix, a throttle read off the intervals a shared supply crossed its cap, the penalty a unit pays for its place on the network (read from the past units that sat across the boundary and applied to the plan's blocks) and a shared pool's response to the load the plan puts on the supply; a benchmark rate and a mean pool share carried unchanged file two members of the call wrongly.
driver_concrete: Each H1 2027 run's days are the benchmark's bridged by the slowest data-parallel rank on the run's own document mix, the fill of best-fit packing on the 2027 long-form mix, hall B's throttle at its 2027 load with the research pool at its measured back-off (node states less the registry's held nodes against the load the registered runs put on the hall) and a 22 per cent penalty for the one block across hall B's two pods (the 2026 node lists against each run's steady step), so the careful pass files kide-34b-v3 late and kide-8b-v4 fitting.
stump: The careful but hurried pass files kide-34b-v3 late (the pool at its mean share adds about 90 nodes of load in February to mid-March, when the pool is off) and kide-8b-v4 fitting (no pod penalty for its block across both of hall B's pods).
results: R1 the 2026 run ledger reconciled to scheduler GPU-hours; R2 the 2026 bridge from benchmark days to actual days by cause, with the blocks across both pods; R3 the per-rank cost model and each 2027 long-context run's slowest-rank overhead; R4 each 2027 best-fit run's packing fill; R5 the extra time a step takes for a job across both pods; R6 the research pool's busy nodes at 800 reserved; R7 hall B's throttle response and each hall B run's mean step stretch in 2027 with the pool at its measured back-off; R8 each 2027 run's expected days against its window; R9 the late set with each late run's fix; R10 each run's finish; R11 each run's 80 per cent range; R12 each run's bridge cause by cause
one_fact_test: 'the research pool takes no hall B nodes once the reservations alone nearly fill the contract' rescues R6 and R7: 2 of 12 (effort.py); the pod penalty, kide-8b-v4's verdict and the hall B runs' days stay lost
